## Results

Publish the full accepted authored resolution of **30006419 / OWR-14299521-012**, rank **969**, as **claimed_solved, 2/5** substantive author approaches.

- **General admissible-energy formulation: negative for Reshetnyak energy.** A smooth sphere homeomorphism into a compact smooth Riemannian sphere is locally minimizing against all matching-trace Sobolev competitors with the source's neighborhoodwise quantifier, while its infinitesimal distortion is essentially unbounded. The map is not KS/Dirichlet-harmonic or a global homotopy minimizer.
- **Separate fixed Korevaar–Schoen formulation: affirmative.** The complete-target theorem has nonsharp bound **Q = 4 + sqrt(17)**, within the stated metric-Sobolev differentiation and domain-chain-rule framework. No isoperimetric or topological target hypothesis is used in that argument.
- Both independent mathematical audits accept both complete arguments unchanged. Audit B includes a separate full KS appendix audit.

## Packet and provenance

The [packet README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/32eaecaa8907dbf674e65b138b000cdcc49004ae/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006419/README.md) links the complete proof, KS theorem, and both audits. All **22** original author/audit files are byte-preserved inside the **30-file source-free publication packet**. Historical pre-audit/no-publication wording remains in the original freeze; the wrapper and acceptance reports supply the later disposition.

Exact source scope is pinned to [arXiv:2503.08553v1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.08553v1), Question 1.9 and Definitions 3.1 and 6.1, and [OWR Report 30/2025](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/52249), printed page 1625. The [author's bibliography](https://people.math.ethz.ch/~damameier/research.html) reports the journal publication, but **the final publisher text was not retrieved or inspected**. Full-PDF retrieval and the particular inspected text/rendered pages are distinguished in the frozen ledgers. This publication step is not a new literature review.

AI-assisted and unrefereed. No human-peer-review, proof-assistant, historical-novelty, or optimal-constant claim. Only authored mathematics, audits and public verification metadata are included; no copied sources, dataset contents or private coordination files.

## Verification

- Author: **257 exact algebra controls**, byte-identical replay.
- Audit A: independent mixed symbolic/exact and numerical controls, byte-identical replay in the tested environment.
- Audit B: **675 mixed checks** in complete local normal and optimized runs, including two identity checks against the already-retrieved source PDFs. Default portable source-free replay runs the remaining **673**, explicitly omitting those two PDF-input checks. Replay is not fresh retrieval or source inspection.
- Normal, optimized, unrelated-directory and remote-reconstructed source-free replays pass. **67 mutation guards** reject altered, missing, extra, symlinked or improperly re-anchored artifacts, including with Python optimization enabled.
- Every one of the **31 changed remote paths**, totalling **532,483 bytes**, was fetched by blob SHA and compared byte-for-byte. Branch-tree paths, modes, blob SHAs and sizes were checked. The commit was assembled using SHA-only tree entries.
- The actual commit comparison contains 30 added packet files and exactly one removed/added queue row. Only the target's **Status, Turns and Findings** cells change; all unrelated queue content is preserved.

Finite controls support calculation and artifact integrity; the complete proofs and mathematical audits address the analytic claims. Check counts do not formally certify those claims.
